arStrings.szText: "What of the other witches? Are they finished with the Tree?"
Some among us will mourn its loss. Its knowledge. We witches have long benefited by serving the Tree. As have you.
PLAYER LEAD IN: "What of the other witches? Are they finished with the Tree?" - Taissa muses on how other witches might react to burning the Tree.
But each benefit has come with a cost. My soul can no longer pay it.
Feeling the weight of all the work she has had to do for the Tree over the years.
